cohort: The study included 55 women of child-bearing age treated at a single institution for NSCLC between 2010 and 2021, 50 of whom had an oncogene driver.
finding: Nine of 55 (16%) women were diagnosed with oncogene-driven NSCLC during or within a year of pregnancy, with early pregnancies often terminated and later pregnancies delivered preterm to avoid fetal exposure, while alternative paths to motherhood like adoption and gestational surrogacy proved feasible.
mod_finding: One later pregnancy was delivered preterm to avoid fetal exposure to targeted therapy.
